config.scope: Offline evaluation of recorded PhysX wheel-ground contact, independent of training rewards
config.contact_definition: At least one valid native wheel-ground contact point with separation <= tolerance; no normal-force threshold
config.invalid_contact_geometry: Zero-normal entries, including all-zero placeholders, cannot prove contact; absent another valid touching point, classify unknown

scope: Four nominal recordings; contact eligibility and contact-conditioned sliding diagnostics

native_force_audit.force_velocity_timing: completed-substep force/impulse divided by dt, paired with post-step material velocity; power proxy, not exact step work

cells.material_velocity_point_weighting: Unweighted RMS over points meeting separation tolerance with a valid native normal; no force threshold or force weighting
limitations: Native separation is collision geometry evidence, not an independently measured surface gap.
Forces and separation belong to the completed substep; rigid twist is sampled after that step.
Friction corroboration is wheel aggregate plus separate friction-anchor dissipation, not a pointwise cone certificate.
Zero-normal entries, including all-zero placeholders, cannot prove contact or separation; absent another valid touching point, the state is unknown.
Contact continuity alone is not full stop-task success; old force-gated slide/stop/heading gates are not reused as new success rates.
